scope: Independent initialization and data-order/augmentation seeds for both real and quaternion CIFAR-10 ResNet-20 baselines, using the discovery-stage recipe and fixed split. Two seeds supplement discovery seed 2026; no test inference or hyperparameter selection on replication outcomes. These are baseline models, not yet a compression replication. The subsequent compression protocol must be registered before examining its outcomes.
pause: Create STOP in the active seed output to pause after a batch; resume with the same command after removing it. Completion is checkpointed each epoch.
